milestones.description: Plan: 'land a cheap threat early (Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Murktide Regent)' — first threat cast by turn 2.
Softer variant of threat_by_2 for the same plan sentence 'land a cheap threat early' — gradient between turn-2 and never.
Plan: 'then protect it and race' / 'Counter their key spells with Daze, Force of Will, Spell Pierce' — protection castable while a threat is on our board. Ported from process_metrics.plan_adherence.
Plan: 'burn their blockers and face with Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning' — face vs creature split of burn targeting. Ported from process_metrics burn_target_split.
Plan: 'Wasteland their duals' — rate the Wasteland sacrifice activation is taken when offered on a play menu.
Plan: 'race while denying their mana' / 'count clock vs their outs' — burn pointed while the opponent is at 6 or less (reach).

notes: Generalisation of the UR-Delver triple in eval/process_metrics.py (THREATS/PROTECTION/BURN) into milestones.v1 data.
